title: Rust gateway provisions a link-local DODAG ID that cannot satisfy root key authority
description: Security review P1. Gateway::new in rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs sets root_addr and DODAG ID to identity_pubkey_link_local. The convergence DIO admission path requires a root-rank signer to bind full ygg_addr_from_pubkey(pubkey) to the DODAG ID, while spec defines root/DODAG identity as primary 02xx. With a link-local DODAG, a legitimate gateway root DIO is classified as Peer then rejected for role mismatch (or mismatches a correctly configured 02xx DODAG), preventing authenticated joins and weakening root identity semantics. Provision gateway root_addr/dodag_id from the full key-derived primary 02xx address and retain a separate link-local control source; add gateway-to-node authenticated DIO admission coverage.
